name: StarCoder
description: First-generation 15.5B parameter code generation foundation model developed by BigCode (Hugging Face & ServiceNow), trained on 1 trillion tokens across 80+ programming languages with 8K context and multi-query attention.
notes: Released under OpenRAIL-M v1 license with strict data governance allowing code attribution and opt-out.

name: CodeGeeX4
description: Open code generation foundation model series (9B parameters) developed by Zhipu AI, pre-trained on the GLM-4 architecture with 128K context support for repository-scale code completion, debugging, and cross-language translation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; ranks among the strongest sub-10B coding models on SWE-bench Lite and HumanEval.

name: Snowflake Arctic
description: Snowflake's 480B parameter open Mixture-of-Experts foundation model that activates only 17B parameters per token using a 128-expert architecture designed for enterprise SQL generation, coding, and instruction compliance.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed including weights and training recipes; optimized for enterprise data lakehouse workloads.

name: Gemma 2 9B
description: Google's 9B parameter open foundation model in the Gemma 2 family, trained with knowledge distillation from larger teacher models and sliding-window local/global attention to punch above its weight class.
notes: Available under the Gemma Open Terms of Use; widely deployed for consumer GPU and enterprise on-premise inference.

name: Phi-3.5-MoE
description: Microsoft Research's lightweight open Mixture-of-Experts model containing 16x3.8B parameters (activating 6.6B parameters per token) with 128K context support, outperforming models twice its active size on multi-step reasoning.
notes: MIT licensed; trained on synthetic data and curated educational web literature.

name: Qwen2.5-Coder-32B
description: Alibaba Cloud's flagship 32.5B parameter open code generation model matching GPT-4o level coding performance across benchmarks with 128K context window, 5.5 trillion training tokens, and support for 92 programming languages.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; recognized as one of the most capable open-weights coding models available for local developer hosting.

name: OpenCodeInterpreter
description: Open code generation suite developed by Tsinghua and Waterloo that integrates code execution feedback and compiler error logs into iterative multi-turn code refinement, bridging the gap to proprietary code interpreters.
notes: Checkpoints based on DeepSeek-Coder and CodeLlama with specialized execution tuning datasets.

name: CogVLM
description: Powerful open visual language foundation model that connects visual processing directly into the language model via a Visual Expert module in every Transformer layer, avoiding loss of image detail during projection.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed code; supports fine-grained visual grounding with pixel-level coordinate predictions.

name: DeepSeek-VL
description: Open vision-language model family (1.3B and 7B) by DeepSeek engineered for diverse real-world multimodal scenarios, including high-resolution document parsing, diagram understanding, and web UI layout reasoning.
notes: Permissive DeepSeek license allowing commercial use; processes arbitrary resolution images via hybrid tiling encoders.

name: LLaVA-NeXT-Video
description: Open-source video understanding model developed by the LLaVA team that extends image-language pre-training with spatio-temporal pooling to reason over long video sequences, action recognition, and temporal video QA.
notes: Supports zero-shot video dialogue with strong performance across Video-MME and ActivityNet QA benchmarks.

name: Video-ChatGPT
description: Multimodal conversational model by MBZUAI designed for detailed video dialogue, combining a spatio-temporal video encoder with Vicuna LLM to produce temporal descriptions, causal explanations, and creative video summaries.
notes: Released with the 100K Video-Instruction dataset and comprehensive quantitative video evaluation protocols.

name: AnimateDiff-Lightning
description: Distilled motion model developed by ByteDance that accelerates video generation from text prompts and still images, reducing AnimateDiff sampling requirements to 1, 2, 4, or 8 steps with zero loss in visual quality.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed checkpoints compatible with arbitrary Stable Diffusion v1.5 community checkpoints.

name: Stable Audio 2.0
description: Generative audio model by Stability AI capable of producing up to three minutes of structured full-length music, ambient sound effects, and audio-to-audio style transformations at 44.1 kHz stereo from text descriptions.
notes: Trained exclusively on licensed AudioSparx library audio to guarantee copyright safety for commercial creators.

name: AudioLDM 2
subtype: General Audio, Music, & Speech Latent Diffusion Model
description: Latent diffusion model developed by University of Surrey and Imperial College London utilizing Language of Audio (LOA) representations to unify sound effects, musical compositions, and spoken text generation.
notes: CC-BY-NC-SA-4.0 licensed; checkpoints include AudioLDM-2-Large and specialized AudioLDM-2-Music.

name: MusicGen-Melody
description: Specialized autoregressive model by Meta AI that accepts both textual prompts and reference audio melodies (humming, whistling, guitar chords) to generate conditioned stereo music adhering to the reference melodic contour.
notes: MIT licensed code with weights for non-commercial research; released within Meta's AudioCraft framework.

name: Graphormer
description: Microsoft Research's standard-setting Transformer architecture for graph-structured data and molecular chemistry, winning the Open Catalyst Challenge and OGB Large-Scale Challenge for quantum chemistry property prediction.
notes: MIT licensed; incorporates centrality encoding and spatial encoding to model 3D molecular graph geometry.

name: AutoAWQ
description: High-speed 4-bit quantization package based on the Activation-aware Weight Quantization (AWQ) algorithm by MIT HAN Lab, delivering faster kernel inference than GPTQ with minimal perplexity degradation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; natively supported by vLLM, TGI, and Hugging Face Transformers for production deployment.

name: GPTQModel
description: Production quantization toolkit succeeding AutoGPTQ with up to 4x faster model calibration, optimized Triton kernels, and broad architecture support for quantized model serialization across Intel and NVIDIA hardware.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; modern continuation of post-training quantization tooling developed by ModelCloud.

name: llamafile
description: Mozilla initiative by Justine Tunney that collapses an LLM weights file and a complete llama.cpp runtime into a single, multi-platform binary executable that runs locally on Windows, macOS, Linux, and FreeBSD without installation.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; leverages Cosmopolitan Libc to generate universal cross-OS binaries with built-in web UIs.

name: TabbyAPI
description: Lightweight, highly optimized local serving engine built on ExLlamaV2 that provides an OpenAI-compatible REST API for serving EXL2 quantized models with ultra-fast inference speeds on consumer GPUs.
notes: AGPL-3.0 licensed; includes native API authentication tokens, speculative decoding, and streaming completions.

name: KTransformers
subtype: Heterogeneous CPU/GPU Flexible MoE Inference Framework
description: Advanced inference framework created by Tsinghua and KVCache.ai that enables running giant Mixture-of-Experts models (like DeepSeek-V2) on a single 24GB GPU by intelligently offloading non-critical experts to CPU RAM.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; incorporates custom kernel optimizations and 2-bit quantization for expert parameters.

name: LangSmith
subtype: Enterprise LLM Application Lifecycle & Debugging Platform
description: Production observability, debugging, dataset management, and evaluation platform built by LangChain to trace multi-agent workflows, monitor token latencies, and run regression test suites on live LLM applications.
notes: Provides deep execution tree visualizations for complex recursive agents; offers free developer tiers and enterprise deployments.

name: Arize AI
description: Enterprise machine learning and generative AI observability platform that detects data drift, performance degradation, and embedding distribution anomalies across production AI deployments with root-cause analysis.
notes: Parent commercial platform of the open-source Arize Phoenix tool; specializes in UMAP 3D vector space cluster analysis.

name: W&B Weave
subtype: Lightweight Toolkit for GenAI Tracing & Evaluation
description: Lightweight generative AI development toolkit by Weights & Biases that enables developers to log, trace, evaluate, and monitor LLM calls and multi-turn agent interactions with a single decorator `@weave.op()`.
notes: Integrates seamlessly into existing W&B team dashboards; supports automated evaluation scorecards and regression testing.

name: Deepchecks
subtype: Continuous Testing Suite for ML & LLM Applications
description: Open-source continuous testing and validation framework that checks tabular, computer vision, and LLM systems for data integrity errors, distribution shifts, hallucinations, and prompt injection vulnerabilities throughout the ML lifecycle.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed open-source package; includes Deepchecks LLM Evaluation suite for automated RAG validation.

name: UpTrain
description: Open-source evaluation platform that provides pre-built metrics to assess LLM outputs on response tone, factual accuracy, context relevance, language guideline compliance, and jailbreak vulnerability.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; features 20+ automated evaluation metrics and root-cause analysis for low-scoring outputs.

name: Fiddler AI
description: Enterprise AI observability and model governance platform offering unified monitoring, real-time guardrails, fairness and bias audits, and explainable AI metrics for predictive models and LLM applications.
notes: Provides compliance reporting aligned with EU AI Act and NIST AI Risk Management Framework standards.

name: Rebuff
description: Open-source security framework that protects LLM applications from prompt injection attacks using a 4-layer defense: heuristic filtering, LLM detection, vector database canary tokens, and signature matching.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; maintained under Protect AI, utilizing canary tokens in system prompts to catch prompt leaks.

name: TextGrad
subtype: Automatic Differentiation via Text Feedback Framework
description: Pioneering optimization framework from Stanford that implements 'backpropagation via text', allowing AI systems to automatically optimize prompts, code solutions, and model weights based on textual loss feedback.
notes: MIT licensed; automatically iteratively tunes system prompts to maximize performance against benchmark test sets.

name: Docling
subtype: High-Precision Document Parsing & Table Extraction Library
description: Open-source document parsing library created by IBM Research that parses complex PDF, DOCX, and PPTX documents with advanced layout recognition, accurate multi-page table structure recovery, and clean Markdown export for RAG.
notes: MIT licensed; features specialized deep neural network models for complex financial and scientific tables.

name: Semantic Router
subtype: Ultra-Fast Semantic Decision Layer for LLMs & Agents
description: Ultra-fast decision routing layer developed by Aurelio AI that routes user prompts to specialized tools, models, or guardrail filters using fast vector embeddings instead of slow and expensive LLM classification calls.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers routing decisions in single-digit milliseconds, eliminating costly intent classification turns.

name: RouteLLM
description: Open-source framework developed by LMSYS Org to dynamically route queries between expensive frontier models (GPT-4o) and cheaper open models (Llama 3 8B), reducing API costs by up to 85% while preserving 95% response quality.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; trained on preference data from LMSYS Chatbot Arena to predict task complexity.

name: Open WebUI
subtype: Self-Hosted Extensible Web Interface for Local & Remote LLMs
description: User-friendly, feature-packed self-hosted web interface designed for Ollama and OpenAI-compatible APIs, providing multi-user authentication, document RAG, voice interaction, and customizable Python pip pipelines.
notes: MIT licensed; one of the most widely adopted open-source frontends for managing private enterprise and local AI deployments.

name: Supermaven
subtype: Ultra-Fast 300K Context AI Code Completion Engine
description: Ultra-fast code completion tool built by Jacob Jackson (creator of TabNine) featuring an industry-leading 300,000-token context window and sub-second keystroke latency for VS Code, JetBrains, and Neovim.
notes: Acquired by Cursor in 2024; powered by the custom Babble architecture specifically optimized for code modeling.

name: Blackbox AI
subtype: AI Developer Search & Code Autocomplete Platform
description: AI coding companion and search engine for developers that autocompletes code across 20+ programming languages, extracts code from video tutorials, and provides contextual answers to complex programming questions.

subtype: AI Dev Agent for Code Review & Bug Explanations

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen
description: Family of open reasoning models (1.5B, 7B, 14B, 32B) distilled by DeepSeek from DeepSeek-R1 outputs using Qwen2.5 base checkpoints, bringing frontier chain-of-thought mathematical reasoning to accessible model sizes.

name: DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama
description: Open reasoning models (8B and 70B parameter sizes) distilled from DeepSeek-R1 onto Meta's Llama 3.1 architecture, demonstrating state-of-the-art chain-of-thought mathematical, coding, and logical reasoning.
notes: Permissive Llama 3.1 Community License; accessible for consumer GPU execution with llama.cpp or vLLM.

name: Mistral Large 2
description: Mistral AI's flagship 123B dense language model featuring a 128K context window, advanced multilingual fluency across 80+ coding languages, and state-of-the-art reasoning on code and math benchmarks.
notes: Available under the Mistral Research License for academic use and via Mistral API / cloud hyperscalers for commercial deployments.

name: Codestral Mamba
subtype: Mamba2 State Space Code Generation Model
description: Open code model built on the Mamba2 State Space Model (SSM) architecture by Mistral AI, delivering linear-time scaling with context length and fast token generation with 256K token context windows.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers fast inference regardless of input context length due to state-space formulation.

name: Gemma 2 27B
description: Google DeepMind's flagship 27B parameter dense open model that outperforms larger 70B models on reasoning, instruction following, and factual QA benchmarks while running comfortably on single consumer GPUs.
notes: Released under the Gemma Open Terms of Use; features alternating local sliding window attention and global attention.

name: Qwen2-VL-72B
description: Alibaba Cloud's flagship 72B multimodal vision-language model featuring Dynamic Resolution visual processing to understand videos over 20 minutes, complex charts, web UI screenshots, and multilingual text in images.
notes: Scores near GPT-4o on visual document and math benchmarks (DocVQA, MathVista, Video-MME).

name: InternLM2.5
description: Open-source foundation model series (7B and 20B) by Shanghai AI Lab featuring native 1-million-token context windows, outstanding tool-use abilities, and state-of-the-art mathematical and coding reasoning.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; includes native support for agentic tool use and deep document analysis.

name: Claude 3 Haiku
description: Anthropic's compact, ultra-fast multimodal model engineered to process long-context documents and high-resolution images with near-instantaneous response times and industry-leading cost efficiency.
notes: Supports 200K token context windows; widely used in high-volume customer service and enterprise document extraction.

name: Whisper-Large-v2
description: OpenAI's milestone 1.55B parameter automatic speech recognition foundation model, trained on 680,000 hours of labeled multilingual audio with high robustness to accents, background noise, and technical jargon.
notes: MIT licensed; established the global benchmark for open-source multilingual speech recognition and translation.

name: BGE-Large-EN-v1.5
subtype: High-Accuracy English Dense Text Embedding Model
description: Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence (BAAI) flagship 335M parameter dense embedding model optimized for English semantic search, ranking at the top of the Massive Text Embedding Benchmark (MTEB).
notes: MIT licensed; produces 1024-dimensional normalized vector embeddings widely used in production RAG systems.

name: Jina-Reranker-v2
description: High-speed cross-encoder reranker model designed by Jina AI supporting 100+ languages and 1024 token query-document pairs, boosting search retrieval accuracy and precision in complex RAG pipelines.
notes: CC-BY-NC-4.0 / commercial API license; outscores dense retrievers by evaluating cross-attention interaction.

name: CRM (Convolutional Reconstruction Model)
subtype: Single Image to High-Fidelity 3D Textured Mesh Model
description: Feed-forward 3D generative model by Tsinghua and Shengshu that converts a single input image into a complete, high-fidelity 3D textured mesh in just 10 seconds without test-time optimization.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; predicts canonical multi-view coordinate maps to reconstruct clean watertight 3D geometry.

name: OpenShape
description: Groundbreaking multi-modal foundation model aligning 3D shapes with text and image representations across millions of 3D objects, enabling zero-shot 3D classification, retrieval, and text-guided 3D editing.
notes: MIT licensed; trained on Enriched ShapeNet and Objaverse datasets using contrastive representation learning.

name: MobileVLM
description: Fast multimodal vision-language model architecture engineered by Meituan for mobile and edge devices, utilizing lightweight MobileNetV4/MobileLLaMA backbones to achieve real-time visual chat on consumer hardware.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; delivers up to 21.5 tokens/sec on Qualcomm Snapdragon smartphone processors.

name: RT-2 (Robotic Transformer 2)
description: Pioneering Vision-Language-Action model by Google DeepMind that transfers web-scale multimodal pre-training directly into robotic control commands, enabling robots to perform generalized physical manipulation from natural instructions.
notes: Casts robot motor actions directly as text tokens in output language space, enabling emergent physical tool use.

name: Lepton AI
subtype: Pythonic Developer Cloud Platform for AI Deployments
description: Cloud platform created by Yangqing Jia (creator of Caffe) that allows developers to package, build, and deploy production AI models and web services into serverless cloud infrastructure in minutes with a Python SDK.
notes: Apache 2.0 open client SDK; provides turn-key endpoints for Llama, Whisper, and Stable Diffusion.

name: Anyscale
subtype: Managed Ray Platform for Distributed AI Scaling
description: Managed cloud compute platform built by the creators of Ray, enabling engineering teams to scale machine learning training, fine-tuning, batch inference, and model serving across hundreds of GPU clusters effortlessly.
notes: Commercial foundation behind the open-source Ray project; provides managed Ray clusters across AWS and GCP.

name: Predibase
description: Developer platform for fine-tuning open-source LLMs (Llama 3, Mistral) and serving hundreds of specialized LoRA adapters simultaneously on a single GPU instance with sub-second adapter swapping via LoRAX.
notes: Created by the authors of Ludwig; dramatically reduces the infrastructure costs of task-specialized LLMs.

name: LoRAX
description: Open-source multi-LoRA inference engine developed by Predibase that allows serving thousands of fine-tuned LoRA adapters on a single GPU with dynamic adapter loading, memory paging, and tensor parallelism.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; features Segmented Gather matrix multiplication to batch requests across multiple adapters.

name: Hugging Face Optimum
description: Extension of Hugging Face Transformers that exports, quantizes, and accelerates model performance across specialized hardware backends including Intel OpenVINO, ONNX Runtime, AWS Inferentia, and Apple Silicon.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; automates graph fusions, operator replacements, and multi-precision quantizations.

name: Intel Extension for PyTorch (IPEX)
subtype: Hardware Optimization Extension for PyTorch on Intel
description: Official Python extension by Intel that delivers hardware optimizations, vector intrinsics (AVX-512, AMX), and FP16/BF16/INT8 mixed-precision acceleration for PyTorch on Intel CPUs, GPUs, and Gaudi processors.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; accelerates transformer models by up to 4x on Intel Xeon Scalable processors.

name: Apple Core ML Tools
subtype: Model Conversion & Optimization Toolkit for Apple Silicon
description: Apple's official open-source Python package that converts trained models from PyTorch, TensorFlow, and ONNX into the optimized Core ML format (.mlpackage) for native on-device acceleration on Apple NPUs.
notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed; supports post-training weight palettization, pruning, and quantization.

name: Marlin
description: Breakthrough GPU kernel library developed by IST Austria that executes 4-bit FP16xINT4 matrix multiplications close to ideal hardware memory limits, speeding up LLM token generation by up to 4x.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; integrated natively into vLLM and AutoAWQ for production-scale quantized serving.

name: Flash-Decoding
description: Inference acceleration kernel created by Tri Dao and the FlashAttention team that parallelizes attention computation across keys and values during generation, speeding up long-context decoding by up to 8x.
notes: BSD-3-Clause licensed; resolves the memory bandwidth bottleneck during long-context generation steps.

name: Lakera Guard
subtype: Enterprise Real-Time GenAI Security & Guardrail API
description: Developer security API developed by Lakera that inspects user prompts and LLM outputs in sub-50 milliseconds to block prompt injection attacks, jailbreaks, data leakage, and toxic content.
notes: Trained continuously on real-world threat vectors discovered via the Gandalf red-teaming game.

name: ModelScan
subtype: Protection Against Malicious Model Serialization Payloads
description: Open-source security scanner created by Protect AI that inspects serialized machine learning model files (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras, Pickles) for embedded arbitrary code execution exploits before loading.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; essential tool for verifying third-party Hugging Face model checkpoints in CI pipelines.

name: LangChain Core
description: Core dependency package of the LangChain ecosystem that defines the foundational abstractions for messages, prompt templates, document loaders, chat models, and LangChain Expression Language (LCEL).
notes: MIT licensed; lightweight dependency decoupled from partner packages to guarantee stability and minimal bloat.

name: LlamaIndex Core
subtype: Foundational Data Framework Core for LLM Applications
description: Core orchestration and indexing package for LlamaIndex that provides node parsers, query engines, retriever routers, and evaluation hooks for building complex Retrieval-Augmented Generation architectures.
notes: MIT licensed; decoupled architecture allowing modular installation of specific vector store and LLM integration plugins.

name: AutoGen AgentChat
description: High-level conversational multi-agent package within Microsoft's rewritten AutoGen 0.4 architecture, providing declarative team structures (RoundRobinGroupChat, SelectorGroupChat) and resilient agent message loops.
notes: MIT licensed; built on top of the asynchronous event-driven AutoGen Core runtime.

name: CopilotKit
subtype: Open-Source In-App AI Copilots & Agents Framework
description: Open-source React and TypeScript framework that allows frontend developers to embed custom in-app AI copilots, sidebar assistants, interactive canvas agents, and AI-powered textareas directly into web applications.
notes: MIT licensed; features CoAgents for synchronizing LangGraph multi-agent backend state with frontend UI state.

name: AG2
subtype: Community Evolution of AutoGen for Multi-Agent Systems
description: Open-source multi-agent development framework evolving the original AutoGen codebase under community governance, focused on production resilience, tool integrations, and multi-agent group conversation orchestration.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; represents the community continuation of AutoGen 0.2 series.

name: Model Context Protocol Python SDK
subtype: Official Python Reference Implementation for Model Context Protocol
description: Official Python SDK provided by Anthropic and the MCP community implementing client and server transports (stdio, SSE) for connecting generative AI agents to external databases, files, and executable tools.
notes: MIT licensed; canonical implementation used by developers to create interoperable agent tools for Claude Desktop and Cursor.

name: Goose
subtype: Open-Source Autonomous AI Agent for Developers
description: Open-source developer agent created by Block (Square) that runs directly on developer machines, autonomously executing multi-file codebase edits, terminal commands, and system tasks via Model Context Protocol (MCP).
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; built with Rust with desktop UI and CLI versions supporting custom MCP server toolkits.

name: Claude Engineer
description: Open-source command-line software engineering assistant powered by Claude 3.5 Sonnet, capable of autonomous codebase navigation, multi-file refactoring, code execution, and web research.
notes: MIT licensed; early viral community agent leveraging Claude's computer use and tool-calling capabilities.

name: Roo Code
description: Powerful community-driven fork of Cline for VS Code featuring custom personas (Architect, Code, Ask), sound feedback, custom system prompts, and native Model Context Protocol support for complex software engineering.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; provides discrete role modes to prevent context pollution during large multi-turn architecture tasks.

name: Cline
subtype: Autonomous Coding Agent Extension with MCP
description: Autonomous AI software engineering agent extension for VS Code that reads code, writes files, runs bash terminal commands, navigates browsers, and connects to external MCP tools with human-in-the-loop approvals.
notes: Apache 2.0 licensed; formerly known as Claude Dev. Connects to any LLM via OpenRouter, Anthropic, or Ollama.

name: Kindo
description: Enterprise AI management platform integrating 200+ commercial and open-source foundation models into unified internal corporate workflows with SOC 2 compliance, centralized billing, and custom workflow automations.
notes: Allows enterprise employees to securely query private company files across OpenAI, Anthropic, and open-source models.

name: Coda AI
subtype: Collaborative Doc & Table Workflow AI Assistant
description: Integrated generative AI assistant inside Coda's all-in-one collaborative workspace that automates table data entry, categorizes feedback, generates structured product roadmaps, and summarizes doc revisions.
